title: Inter: Pio Esposito's double beats France — and nine matches to Christmas
description:
Inter can't bench Pio Esposito now.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=73

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED (Inter.it, FIGC, Nov 12): Pio Esposito scored twice as Italy beat France 3–1 at San Siro; Davide Frattesi scored the other, turning in a cross from Federico Dimarco.
CONFIRMED (Inter.it, Nov 12): Petar Sucic equalized for Croatia at Wembley but England won 2–1; Hakan Çalhanoğlu came on in Izmir as Belgium beat Turkey 2–1.
CONFIRMED (Inter.it, Nov 13): Inter published nine matches to Christmas, ending with the Supercoppa Italiana against Lazio at San Siro on Dec 22.
REPORTED (Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews, Nov 12): Carlos Augusto's renewal to 2031 is said to be in its closing stages. Inter have announced nothing.
REPORTED (Sky Sport Italia via FCInter1908, Nov 12): the San Siro screen showed Alessandro Bastoni for a booking, but Sky reported the screen was wrong and Frattesi was the player booked.
